label: Left/Right camel-case limb names with the spine numbered from the top
notes: For 24-bone auto-rig skeletons named in the Mixamo style: Hips, three spine joints named Spine (top, where the neck and shoulders attach), Spine01 and Spine02 (lowest), neck, Head, and Left/Right Shoulder, Arm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot, ToeBase. No finger joints. Spine01, head_end and headfront stand at no landmark and are reported as unmapped. Checked against rigged files returned by two generation services. Mixamo's own skeletons number the spine from the bottom (Spine, Spine1, Spine2) and prefix every name; they need their own table.
